title: The Last Prom
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Theo Sandoval, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
